verdict.rationale: a-Shell is a Unix-like terminal app for iOS. Routing all device internet traffic through an exit node is a VPN or mesh-networking capability, which is outside what a local terminal emulator does. The pack only shows network utilities such as nslookup and whois, nothing about exit nodes or VPN routing, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can route all my internet traffic through a specific device on my network using an exit node
